{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794637144162,"sessionID":"ses_e27500777ffeJCGjiw6rZBW5Ll","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"Hi92cPert67F625r","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"which node bun python3 && python3 -c '\nimport zlib, struct\n\ndef read_png(path):\n    data = open(path, \"rb\").read()\n    pos = 8\n    ihdr = None\n    idat = bytearray()\n    while pos < len(data):\n        length, ctype = struct.unpack(\">I4s\", data[pos:pos+8])\n        chunk = data[pos+8:pos+8+length]\n        pos += 12 + length\n        if ctype == b\"IHDR\":\n            w, h, bd, ct, comp, filt, inter = struct.unpack(\">IIBBBBB\", chunk)\n        elif ctype == b\"IDAT\":\n            idat.extend(chunk)\n    raw = zlib.decompress(bytes(idat))\n    bpp = {2: 3, 6: 4}[ct]\n    stride = w * bpp\n    rows = []\n    prev = bytearray(stride)\n    i = 0\n    for y in range(h):\n        f = raw[i]\n        row = bytearray(raw[i+1:i+1+stride])\n        i += 1 + stride\n        if f == 1:\n            for x in range(bpp, stride): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-bpp]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 2:\n            for x in range(stride): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 3:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-bpp] if x >= bpp else 0\n                row[x] = (row[x] + ((a + prev[x]) >> 1)) & 0xff\n        elif f == 4:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-bpp] if x >= bpp else 0\n                b = prev[x]\n                c = prev[x-bpp] if x >= bpp else 0\n                p = a + b - r) < 40:\n                ch = \".\"\n            elif r > g + 40 and r > b + 40:\n                ch = \"R\"\n            elif b > r + 40:\n                ch = \"B\"\n            elif max(r, g, b) < 175 and abs(r - g) < 15 and abs(g - b) < 15:\n                ch = \"#\"\n            else:\n                ch = \"?\"\n            line.append(ch)\n        print(\"  \" + \"\".join(line))\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/opencode/ascii_views.py"},"output":"top: 480x360 bpp=3 bg=(198, 209, 227) red=0 None blue=140601 (242.25666247039496, 183.0949779873543) grey=9596 (215.0976448520217, 172.3494164235098)\nfront: 480x360 bpp=3 bg=(221, 227, 239) red=0 None blue=31199 (222.90256097951857, 151.0274047245104) grey=20520 (204.90009746588694, 283.2171052631579)\nside: 480x360 bpp=3 bg=(221, 227, 239) red=0 None blue=27772 (316.3109606798214, 160.50774161025493) grey=25446 (243.00432287982395, 275.2264403049595)\nback: 480x360 bpp=3 bg=(221, 227, 239) red=0 None blue=25415 (229.55868581546332, 162.83214637025378) grey=22417 (247.44470714190123, 281.0699023062854)\niso: 480x360 bpp=3 bg=(215, 223, 236) red=0 None blue=28135 (236.39761862448907, 199.49688999466855) grey=11747 (293.2128202945433, 200.69439005703583)\nxy_top view=iso az=90 el=-90 dist=5.00 lookat=[1.0, 0.5, 0.2] | tube_b at [1.2, 0.36, 0.28] | handle0=empty | actions 0/198. \"application/json\", \"Accept\": \"application/json, text/event-stream\"}\n\ndef call_render(**kwargs):\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({\n        \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\", \"id\": 1, \"method\": \"tools/call\",\n        \"params\": {\"name\": \"render\", \"arguments\": kwargs}\n    }).encode(), headers=headers)\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:\n        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())\n    for item in data[\"result\"][\"content\"]:\n        if item[\"type\"] == \"text\": txt = item[\"text\"]\n        elif item[\"type\"] == \"image\": img = base64.b64decode(item[\"data\"])\n    return txt, img\n\ndef classify_image(img_bytes):\n    # Write temp or parse directly from bytes\n    pos = 8\n    idat = bytearray()\n    import zlib, struct\n    while pos < len(img_bytes):\n        length, ctype = struct.unpack(\">I4s\", img_bytes[pos:pos+8])\n        chunk = img_bytes[pos+8:pos+8+length]\n        pos += 12 + length\n        if ctype == b\"IHDR\":\n            w, h, bd, ct, comp, filt, inter = struct.unpack(\">IIBBBBB\", chunk)\n        elif ctype == b\"IDAT\":\n            idat.extend(chunk)\n    raw = zlib.decompress(bytes(idat))\n    bpp = 3\n    stride = w * 3\n    prev = bytearray(stride)\n    # classes: 0 = bg, 1 = grey (tube_a), 2 = blue (tube_b)\n    grid = bytearray(w * h)\n    i = 0\n    for y in range(h):\n        f = raw[i]\n        row = bytearray(raw[i+1:i+1+stride])\n        i += 1 + stride\n        if f == 1:\n            for x in range(3, stride): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-3]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 2:\n            for x in range(stride): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 3:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                row[x] = (row[x] + ((a + prev[x]) >> 1)) & 0xff\n        elif f == 4:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                b = prev[x]\n                c = prev[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                p = a + b - c\n                pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)\n                pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)\n                row[x] = (row[x] + pr) & 0xff\n        prev = row\n        # Background color on this scanline from leftmost/rightmost pixel\n        bg0 = (row[0], row[1], row[2])\n        bg1 = (row[-3], row[-2], row[-1])\n        base = y * w\n        for x in range(w):\n            r, g, b = row[x*3], row[x*3+1], row[x*3+2]\n            d0 = abs(r - bg0[0]) + abs(g - bg0[1]) + abs(b - bg0[2])\n            d1 = abs(r - bg1[0]) + abs(g - bg1[1]) + abs(b - bg1[2])\n            if min(d0, d1) <= 6:\n                grid[base + x] = 0\n            elif b - r >= 25:\n                grid[base + x] = 2\n            else:\n                grid[base + x] = 1\n    return w, h, grid\n\ndef blue_centroid(w, h, grid):\n    sx = sy = n = 0\n    for y in range(h):\n        base = y * w\n << 'EOF' > /tmp/opencode/fetch_views.py\nimport urllib.request, json, base64, zlib, struct\n\nurl = \"http://loophole-sim:8000/mcp\"\nheaders = {\"Content-Type\": \"application/json\", \"Accept\": \"application/json, text/event-stream\"}\n\ndef call_render(**kwargs):\n    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps({\n        \"jsonrpc\": \"2.0\", \"id\": 1, \"method\": \"tools/call\",\n        \"params\": {\"name\": \"render\", \"arguments\": kwargs}\n    }).encode(), headers=headers)\n    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:\n        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())\n    for item in data[\"result\"][\"content\"]:\n        if item[\"type\"] == \"text\": txt = item[\"text\"]\n        elif item[\"type\"] == \"image\": img = base64.b64decode(item[\"data\"])\n    return txt, img\n\ndef classify_png(img_bytes):\n    pos = 8\n    idat = bytearray()\n    while pos < len(img_bytes):\n        length, ctype = struct.unpack(\">I4s\", img_bytes[pos:pos+8])\n        chunk = img_bytes[pos+8:pos+8+length]\n        pos += 12 + length\n        if ctype == b\"IHDR\":\n            w, h, bd, ct, comp, filt, inter = struct.unpack(\">IIBBBBB\", chunk)\n        elif ctype == b\"IDAT\":\n            idat.extend(chunk)\n    raw = zlib.decompress(bytes(idat))\n    stride = w * 3\n    prev = bytearray(stride)\n    grid = bytearray(w * h)\n    i = 0\n    for y in range(h):\n        f = raw[i]\n        row = bytearray(raw[i+1:i+1+stride])\n        i += 1 + stride\n        if f == 1:\n            for x in range(3, stride): row[x] = (row[x] + row[x-3]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 2:\n            for x in range(stride): row[x] = (row[x] + prev[x]) & 0xff\n        elif f == 3:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                row[x] = (row[x] + ((a + prev[x]) >> 1)) & 0xff\n        elif f == 4:\n            for x in range(stride):\n                a = row[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                b = prev[x]\n                c = prev[x-3] if x >= 3 else 0\n                p = a + b - c\n                pa, pb, pc = abs(p-a), abs(p-b), abs(p-c)\n                pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)\n                row[x] = (row[x] + pr) & 0xff\n        prev = row\n        base = y * w\n        for x in range(w):\n            r, g, b = row[x*3], row[x*3+1], row[x*3+2]\n            # Sky has r >= 190, g >= 200, b >= 220 and b - r < 40\n            if r >= 188 and g >= 198 and b >= 218 and (b - r) < 42:\n                grid[base + x] = 0\n            elif (b - r) >= 48:\n                grid[base + x] = 2 # blue (tube_b)\n            else:\n                grid[base + x] = 1 # grey (tube_a) or anti-aliased edge\n    return w, h, grid\n\nviews = []\nlook = [1.1, 0.6, 0.15]\nfor el in [-75, -40, -15, 0, 15, 40, 75]:\n    step = 60 if abs(el) == 75 else 36\n    for az in range(0, 360, step):\n        views.append((az, el, 4.8, look))\n# Add orthogonal close-ish views\nfor az, el in [(0, 0), (90, 0), (0, -89), (0, 89), (45, -30), (135, 30)]:\n    views.append((az, el, 3.6, look))\n\nmeta = []\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/views.bin\", \"wb\") as bf:\n    for idx, (az, el, dist, lk) in enumerate(views):\n        txt, img = call_render(azimuth=az, elevation=el, distance=dist, lookat=lk)\n        # Parse actual clamped dist from txt\n        actual_dist = float(txt.split(\"dist=\")[1].split()[0])\n        w, h, grid = classify_png(img)\n        bf.write(grid)\n        meta.append({\"az\": az, \"el\": el, \"dist\": actual_dist, \"lookat\": lk, \"w\": w, \"h\": h})\nwith open(\"/tmp/opencode/views.json\", \"w\") as jf:\n    json.dump(meta, jf)\nprint(f\"Saved {len(meta)} views ({w}x{h})\")\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/opencode/fetch_views.py"},"output":"Saved << 'EOF' > /tmp/opencode/carve.js\nconst fs = require('fs');\n\nconst meta = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/opencode/views.json', 'utf8'));\nconst bin = fs.readFileSync('/tmp/opencode/views.bin');\nconst W = meta[0].w, H = meta[0].h, WH = W * H;\n\nfunction buildCameras(fovyDeg, azSign) {\n  const f = (H / 2) / Math.tan((fovyDeg * Math.PI / 180) / 2);\n  return meta.map((m, idx) => {\n    const az = azSign * m.az * Math.PI / 180;\n    const el = m.el * Math.PI / 180;\n    const fx = Math.cos(az) * Math.cos(el);\n    const fy = Math.sin(az) * Math.cos(el);\n    const fz = Math.sin(el);\n    // right = normalize(cross(f, [0,0,1])) = [fy, -fx, 0] / hypot(fx, fy)\n    const rh = Math.hypot(fx, fy);\n    const rx = fy / rh, ry = -fx / rh, rz = 0;\n    // up = cross(right, f)\n    const ux = ry * fz - rz * fy;\n    const uy = rz * fx - rx * fz;\n    const uz = rx * fy - ry * fx;\n    const cx = m.lookat[0] - m.dist * fx;\n    const cy = m.lookat[1] - m.dist * fy;\n    const cz = m.lookat[2] - m.dist * fz;\n    return { fx, fy, fz, rx, ry, rz, ux, uy, uz, cx, cy, cz, f, offset: idx * WH };\n  });\n}\n\n// Dilate foreground by 1px to tolerate subpixel/antialiasing when testing coarse voxels\nconst dilated = new Uint8Array(bin.length);\nfor (let v = 0; v < meta.length; v++) {\n  const off = v * WH;\n  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {\n    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {\n      let mask = 0;\n      for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {\n        const ny = y + dy;\n        if (ny < 0 || ny >= H) continue;\n        for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {\n          const nx = x + dx;\n          if (nx < 0 || nx >= W) continue;\n          const c = bin[off + ny * W + nx];\n          if (c === 1) mask |= 1;\n          else if (c === 2) mask |= 2;\n        }\n      }\n      dilated[off + y * W + x] = mask;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfor (const azSign of [1, -1]) {\n  for (const fovy of [30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60]) {\n    const cams = buildCameras(fovy, azSign);\n    let fgCount = 0;\n    for (let x = -0.6; x <= 3.0; x += 0.08) {\n      for (let y = -0.6; y <= 2.6; y += 0.08) {\n        for (let z = -0.8; z <= 1.6; z += 0.08) {\n          let misses = 0;\n          for (let i = 0; i < cams.length; i++) {\n            const c = cams[i];\n            const dx = x - c.cx, dy = y - c.cy, dz = z - c.cz;\n            const depth = dx * c.fx + dy * c.fy + dz * c.fz;\n            if (depth <= 0.1) { misses = 99; break; }\n            const u = Math.round((W - 1) / 2 + c.f * (dx * c.rx + dy * c.ry + dz * c.rz) / depth);\n            const vp = Math.round((H - 1) / 2 - c.f * (dx * c.ux + dy * c.uy + dz * c.uz) / depth);\n            if (u < 0 || u >= W || vp < 0 || vp >= H) continue;\n            if (dilated[c.offset + vp * W + u] === 0) {\n              if (++misses > 0) break;\n            }\n          }\n          if (misses === 0) fgCount++;\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    console.log(`azSign=${azSign} fovy=${fovy}: fgVoxels(8cm)=${fgCount}`);\n  }\n}\nEOF\n/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.5/bin/node /tmp/opencode/carve.js"},"output":"azSign=1 fovy=30: fgVoxels(8cm)=199\nazSign=1 fovy=35: Extract surface points of pts5mm (5mm grid)\nconst set5 = new Set();\nfor (const p of pts5mm) {\n  set5.add(`${Math.round(p[0]*200)},${Math.round(p[1]*200)},${Math.round(p[2]*200)}`);\n}\nconst surfLocal = [];\nfor (const p of pts5mm) {\n  const ix = Math.round(p[0]*200), iy = Math.round(p[1]*200), iz = Math.round(p[2]*200);\n  if (!set5.has(`${ix+1},${iy},${iz}`) || !set5.has(`${ix-1},${iy},${iz}`) ||\n      !set5.has(`${ix},${iy+1},${iz}`) || !set5.has(`${ix},${iy-1},${iz}`) ||\n      !set5.has(`${ix},${iy},${iz+1}`) || !set5.has(`${ix},${iy},${iz-1}`)) {\n    surfLocal.push(p);\n  }\n}\nconsole.log('Surface 5mm points:', surfLocal.length);\n\n// Farthest/grid-subsampled surface points of tube_b at 1.0cm (coarse, ~1500 pts) and 0.5cm (fine, ~6000 pts)\nfunction subsampleGrid(pts, cell) {\n  const map = new Map();\n  for (const p of pts) {\n    const k = `${Math.floor(p[0]/cell)},${Math.floor(p[1]/cell)},${Math.floor(p[2]/cell)}`;\n    if (!map.has(k)) map.set(k, p);\n  }\n  return Array.from(map.values());\n}\nconst coarseB = subsampleGrid(surfLocal, 0.035);\nconst medB    = subsampleGrid(surfLocal, 0.015);\nconst fineB   = subsampleGrid(surfLocal, 0.0075);\nconsole.log(`Subsampled B surface: coarse=${coarseB.length}, med=${medB.length}, fine=${fineB.length}`);\n\n// Flatten into Float64Arrays for ultra-fast V8 loops\nfunction flattenPts(pts) {\n  const arr = new Float64Array(pts.length * 3);\n  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i++) {\n    arr[i*3] = pts[i][0]; arr[i*3+1] = pts[i][1]; arr[i*3+2] = pts[i][2];\n  }\n  return arr;\n}\nconst coarseBArr = flattenPts(coarseB);\nconst medBArr    = flattenPts(medB);\nconst fineBArr   = flattenPts(fineB);\n\n// 2. Build 3D EDT of tube_a on [-0.65, 2.95] x [-0.70, 2.18] x [-0.75, 1.01] at h = 0.008m (8mm)!\nconst H_GRID = 0.008;\nconst OX = -0.65, OY = -0.70, OZ = -0.75;\nconst NX = 450, NY = 360, NZ = 220; // 35.64M cells = 142 MB\nconsole.time('edt3d');\nconst sdfA = new Float32Array(NX * NY * NZ);\nconst INF = 1e6;\nsdfA.fill(INF);\n\n// Mark all pts5mm transformed by (R_A, t_A)\nfor (const b of pts5mm) {\n  const ax = R_A[0][0]*b[0] + R_A[0][1]*b[1] + R_A[0][2]*b[2] + t_A[0];\n  const ay = R_A[1][0]*b[0] + R_A[1][1]*b[1] + R_A[1][2]*b[2] + t_A[1];\n  const az = R_A[2][0]*b[0] + R_A[2][1]*b[1] + R_A[2][2]*b[2] + t_A[2];\n  const ix = Math.round((ax - OX) / H_GRID);\n  const iy = Math.round((ay - OY) / H_GRID);\n  const iz = Math.round((az - OZ) / H_GRID);\n  if (ix >= 0 && ix < NX && iy >= 0 && iy < NY && iz >= 0 && iz < NZ) {\n    sdfA[(iz * NY + iy) * NX + ix] = 0;\n  }\n}\n\n// Exact 3D separable Felzenszwalb-Huttenlocher EDT\n{\n  const maxN = Math.max(NX, NY, NZ);\n  const f = new Float32Array(maxN), d = new Float32Array(maxN), v = new Int32Array(maxN), z = new Float32Array(maxN + 1);\n  function edt1d(n) {\n    let k = 0; v[0] = 0; z[0] = -INF; z[1] = INF;\n    for (let q = 1; q < n; q++) {\n      let s = ((f[q] + q * q) - (f[v[k]] + v[k] * v[k])) / (2 * q - 2 * v[k]);\n      while (s <= z[k]) { k--; s = ((f[q] + q * q) - (f[v[k]] + v[k] * v[k])) / (2 * q - 2 * v[k]); }\n      k++; v[k] = q; z[k] = s; z[k + 1] = INF;\n    }\n    k = 0;\n    for (let q = 0; q < n; q++) {\n      while (z[k + 1] < q) k++;\n      const dx = q - v[k];\n      d[q] = dx * dx + f[v[k]];\n    }\n  }\n  // X pass\n  for (let iz = 0; iz < NZ; iz++) {\n    for (let iy = 0; iy < NY; iy++) {\n      const base = (iz * NY + iy) * NX;\n      for (let ix = 0; ix < NX; ix++) f[ix] = sdfA[base + ix];\n      edt1d(NX);\n      for (let ix = 0; ix < NX; ix++) sdfA[base + ix] = d[ix];\n    }\n  }\n  // Y pass\n  for (let iz = 0; iz < NZ; iz++) {\n    for (let ix = 0; ix < NX; ix++) {\n      for (let iy = 0; iy < NY; iy++) f[iy] = sdfA[(iz * NY + iy) * NX + ix];\n      edt1d(NY);\n      for (let iy = 0; iy < NY; iy++) sdfA[(iz * NY + iy) * NX + ix] = d[iy];\n    }\n  }\n  // Z pass + sqrt * H_GRID\n  for (let iy = 0; iy < NY; iy++) {\n    for (let ix = 0; ix < NX; ix++) {\n      for (let iz = 0; iz < NZ; Bi-directional RRT-Connect with Clearance-Sliding!\nfunction solveRRT(margin = 0.010, maxIter = 80000) {\n  const start = { pos: [1.2, 0.36, 0.28], quat: [1, 0, 0, 0], parent: -1 };\n  // Multiple well-separated goal seeds inside workspace [-0.5..2.8]^3\n  const goalSeeds = [\n    { pos: [2.4, 2.4, 1.4], quat: [1, 0, 0, 0], parent: -1 },\n    { pos: [-0.2, 2.3, 1.3], quat: [1, 0, 0, 0], parent: -1 },\n    { pos: [1.2, -0.4, 1.5], quat: [1, 0, 0, 0], parent: -1 },\n    { pos: [2.5, -0.3, 1.2], quat: [1, 0, 0, 0], parent: -1 },\n  ].filter(g => minClearance(g.pos, g.quat, 0.45) >= 0.45);\n  console.log('Valid goal seeds (>0.45m separation):', goalSeeds.length, goalSeeds.map(g => minClearance(g.pos, g.quat, 0).toFixed(3)));\n\n  let treeA = [start];\n  let treeB = goalSeeds.slice();\n  let swapped = false;\n\n  function nearest(tree, q) {\n    let best = 0, bestD = 1e9;\n    for (let i = 0; i < tree.length; i++) {\n      const d = cfgDist(tree[i], q);\n      if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }\n    }\n    return best;\n  }\n\n  function stepToward(from, to, maxStep = 0.08) {\n    const d = cfgDist(from, to);\n    const t = d <= maxStep ? 1.0 : maxStep / d;\n    return {\n      pos: [from.pos[0]+t*(to.pos[0]-from.pos[0]), from.pos[1]+t*(to.pos[1]-from.pos[1]), from.pos[2]+t*(to.pos[2]-from.pos[2])],\n      quat: slerp(from.quat, to.quat, t)\n    };\n  }\n\n  function extend(tree, target, useSlide = true) {\n    let curIdx = nearest(tree, target);\n    let steps = 0;\n    while (steps < 25) {\n      const cur = tree[curIdx];\n      let cand = stepToward(cur, target, 0.07);\n      let c = minClearance(cand.pos, cand.quat, margin);\n      if (c < margin && useSlide) {\n        // Try sliding along 6-DOF clearance gradient!\n        const slid = repel6DOF(cand.pos, cand.quat, margin + 0.008, 4);\n        if (cfgDist(cur, slid) > 0.01 && cfgDist(cur, slid) < 0.14 && minClearance(slid.pos, slid.quat, margin) >= margin) {\n          cand = slid;\n          c = margin;\n        } else {\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n      if (c < margin || !edgeValid(cur, cand, margin)) break;\n      cand.parent = curIdx;\n      tree.push(cand);\n      curIdx = tree.length - 1;\n      if (cfgDist(cand, target) < 1e-4) return { status: 'reached', idx: curIdx };\n      // If treeA itself already reached separation > 0.43m, we can stop immediately!\n      if (!swapped && minClearance(cand.pos, cand.quat, 0) >= 0.43) {\n        return { status: 'goal_direct', idx: curIdx };\n      }\n      steps++;\n    }\n    return steps > 0 ? { status: 'advanced', idx: curIdx } : { status: 'trapped', idx: curIdx };\n  }\n\n  for (let it = 0; it < maxIter; it++) {\n    // Biased sampling: 65% around interlocking region [-0.2..2.6, -0.3..1.9, -0.5..1.2], 35% wider\n    let pos;\n    if (Math.random() < 0.70) {\n      pos = [-0.2 + Math.random()*2.8, -0.3 + Math.random()*2.2, -0.5 + Math.random()*1.7];\n    } else {\n      pos = [-0.5 + Math.random()*3.3, -0.5 + Math.random()*3.3, -0.5 + Math.random()*2.8];\n    }\n    const u1 = Math.random(), u2 = Math.random()*6.283185, u3 = Math.random()*6.283185;\n    const s1 = Math.sqrt(1-u1), s2 = Math.sqrt(u1);\n    let qRand = { pos, quat: [s1*Math.sin(u2), s1*Math.cos(u2), s2*Math.sin(u3), s2*Math.cos(u3)] };\n\n    // Occasionally push colliding samples onto C-space medial surface (OBPRM-style narrow passage sample!)\n    if (minClearance(qRand.pos, qRand.quat, margin) < margin) {\n      if (Math.random() < 0.5) {\n        qRand = repel6DOF(qRand.pos, qRand.quat, margin + 0.010, 6);\n        if (minClearance(qRand.pos, qRand.quat, margin) < margin) continue;\n      } else continue;\n    }\n\n    const resA = extend(treeA, qRand, true);\n    if (resA.status === 'goal_direct') {\n      console.log(`SOLVED directly at iter ${it}! treeA=${treeA.length}`);\n      const path = [];\n      for (let k = resA.idx; k !== -1; k = treeA[k].parent) path.push(treeA[k]);\n      return path.reverse();\n    }\n    if (resA.status !== 'trapped') {\n      const qNew = treeA[resA.idx];\n      const resB = extend(treeB, qNew, true);\n      if (resB.status === 'reached') {\n        console.log(`SOLVED via RRT-Connect at iter ${it}! treeA=${treeA.length}, treeB=${treeB.length}`);\n        let pA = [], pB = [];\n        for (let k = resA.idx; k !== -1; k = treeA[k].parent) pA.push(treeA[k]);\n        for (let k = resB.idx; k !== -1; k = treeB[k].parent) pB.push(treeB[k]);\n        pA.reverse();\n        pB.shift(); // avoid duplicate meeting node\n        const full = swapped ? pB.reverse().concat(pA.reverse()) : pA.concat(pB);\n        //Wait: let's assemble carefully if swapped!\n        if (swapped) {\n          let sPath = [], gPath = [];\n          for (let k = resB.idx; k !== -1; k = treeB[k].parent) sPath.push(treeB[k]);\n          for (let k = resA.idx; k !== -1; k = treeA[k].parent) gPath.push(treeA[k]);\n          sPath.reverse();\n          gPath.shift();\n          return sPath.concat(gPath);\n        } else {\n          return pA.concat(pB);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    if (treeA.length > treeB.length) {\n      const tmp = treeA; treeA = treeB; treeB = tmp;\n      swapped = !swapped;\n    }\n    if ((it + 1) % 5000 === 0) {\n      console.log(`iter ${it+1}: treeA=${treeA.length}, treeB=${treeB.length} (swapped=${swapped})`);\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nconsole.time('rrt');\nconst path = solveRRT(0.010, 80000);\nconsole.timeEnd('rrt');\nif (path) {\n  console.log('Raw path waypoints:', path.length);\n  let minC = 1e9;\n  for (const w of path) {\n    const c = minClearance(w.pos, w.quat, 0);\n    if (c < minC) minC = c;\n  }\n  console.log('Raw path min waypoint clearance:', minC.toFixed(5), 'end clearance:', minClearance(path[path.length-1].pos, path[path.length-1].quat, 0).toFixed(5));\n  fs.writeFileSync('/tmp/opencode/raw_path.json', JSON.stringify(path.map(p => ({ pos: p.pos, quat: p.quat }))));\n}\nEOF\n/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.5/bin/node /tmp/opencode/solve_alpha.js","time":{"start":1794638301226,"end":1794638421374}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1d8c7480f001aip12Fk0z0BKKB","sessionID":"ses_e27500777ffeJCGjiw6rZBW5Ll","messageID":"msg_1d8c3fc7d001TopjKgjzHR4pXO"}}
